## Summary
- Update the Streamline entry in `skin_sources.json` from `allofmeng/streamline_project` to `decentespresso/streamline-js`.
- Preserve `github_release` type and leave all other skin sources unchanged.

## Verification
- Validated the updated `skin_sources.json` parses as JSON.
- Confirmed `decentespresso/streamline-js` provides a published latest GitHub release (`v0.2.28`) with a `.zip` asset, matching `bundle_skins.sh`'s expectations.

## Smoke test on CI/build
- Run skin bundling and verify the downloaded Streamline archive installs as `streamline.js` and the installed skin remains discoverable. Because the repository name also determines the archive filename (`streamline-js.zip` rather than `streamline_project.zip`), check existing skin/update behavior in an upgraded installation.
